summary: Laid-off workers are urged to start using help while severance or benefits are still coming.
realLife: The federal rapid response page advises using services while still employed or while severance, unemployment benefits or other resources are still available.
sources: U.S. Department of Labor, Rapid Response page for workers facing layoffs: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/eta/layoffs/workers
inGame: Needs: severance payments, which the game does not have; unemployment pay can ride on the job-ended event. Scene: needs a producer for layoff-terms.

turns.summary: No one tells the workers about the help available, and they find out late.
turns.writesBack: Benefits start late, and the mood sours.

turns.summary: The worker waits until the pay runs out before seeking help.
turns.writesBack: Money gets tight, and a late journal note shows the delay.

turns.summary: A coworker takes the worker to the help office the next day.
pulledBy: a tie of coworker to the worker
turns.writesBack: The tie gets closer, and the worker starts the search sooner.
